title: Malicious code in reedworker (PyPI)
description: The reedworker package on PyPI version 0.1.0 is part of a malicious campaign involving loader packages that execute code from remote URLs. These packages do not contain the malicious payload themselves but are designed to download and run remote malicious scripts, indicating a coordinated effort to facilitate malicious code execution.
aiSummary: This threat involves the reedworker package (version 0.1.0) on PyPI, identified as part of a campaign deploying multiple loader packages that execute code fetched from remote URLs. While the package itself does not embed the malicious payload, its functionality enables the execution of remote malicious scripts, suggesting it is a tool for delivering malicious code. The campaign is known as '2026-10-voice-synthesis-profiles' and is characterized by clearly malicious intent, including the potential for infostealing or other harmful activities. There is no CVSS score available, and no known exploits in the wild have been reported.
aiImpact: The impact of this threat is the potential execution of arbitrary malicious code on systems that install and run the reedworker package version 0.1.0. This could lead to compromise of the affected system, data theft, or further malware deployment. Since the package acts as a loader for remote scripts, the actual payload and its impact depend on the remote code executed.
